title: Cherry Picking PCR Prep with CSV File
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol transfers samples from a source plate to one of two target plates (to later undergo PCR) as specified in the uploaded CSV file. Samples from each well in the source plate are distributed to its corresponding target plate 6 columns apart. In the case that one of the target plates is filled, the user is prompted to replace it and resume the protocol. In the case that the source plate is depleted, the user is prompted to replace the source plate and upload its respective CSV file to this webpage, download, and run again. In the latter case, the OT-2 "remembers" what wells on the target plate are already filled when a new source plate is introduced (unless user resets the counter - see below). User will also be prompted to replace tip racks during a run if applicable. --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [P20 Single Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 20 µL](https://labware.opentrons.com/opentrons_96_filtertiprack_20ul?category=tipRack) * ThermoScientific 96-well Plate 200µl --- For this protocol, be sure that the pipettes (P20 and P300) are attached. Using the customization fields below, set up your protocol. * Source Plate CSV: Upload a CSV corresponding with the source plate loaded onto the deck. * Transfer Volume: Specify the volume (µL) desired for each well in target plates * P20 Single Mount: Specify which mount the P10 is on (left or right). * Reset Counter: Reset the counter if running with empty target plates. Do not reset the counter if wells in target plate from last run are to be tracked. **Note about CSV** The CSV should be formatted l
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach required pipettes
steps.instruction: Ensure both the P20 Single‑Channel electronic pipette and the P300 pipette are mounted on the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack (20 µL) and a ThermoScientific 96‑well plate (200 µL) for the source plate on the deck, then position the two target plates according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) upload the CSV file that matches the source plate, set the desired transfer volume (µL) for each well, select the mount (left or right) for the P20 single‑channel pipette, and choose whether to reset the well‑counter (reset only if both target plates are empty).

steps.title: Generate and load protocol
steps.instruction: Click “Download your protocol” to obtain the protocol file, then upload this file to the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, source plate, target plates, and both pipettes (refer to Opentrons support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run”. The robot will transfer samples from each source‑well to the corresponding target‑well that is six columns apart, using the volume you specified.

substeps.instruction: If a target plate becomes full, the app will pause; replace the filled target plate and resume the run.

If the source plate is depleted, the app will pause; replace the source plate, upload its new CSV file, download the updated protocol, and run again. The OT‑2 will retain information about already‑filled wells unless you reset the counter.
Replace tip racks whenever the app prompts you to do so.
